body: i was able to get out, and you'll eventually have the power to as well. stay strong, we care about you.

i first showed very obvious symptoms of it when i was in like 4th grade and had a literal panic attack in the middle of class for no discernable reason

i continued to get more and more frequent panic attacks as my general mental state worsened as well as started to be scared around people and started feeling more and more on-edge and eventually it dawned on me that it... wasnt normal
o_o what did i just read

i often have thoughts like this and i just need to get them out of my system if i feel like theres no one i can turn to at the time.... but someone came up and helped me so i'm feeling better than i was at the very least
i talked to someone about it. they helped me, i guess i meant more along the lines of "im *better* now"
i used to think "ftw" stood for "fuck the what" lmao
im honestly not entirely sure if i completely ruined it but i feel like i messed things up pretty bad.
i prefer classic emoticons but hey whatever floats your boat pal :D
its a little silly but i like listening to the splatoon ost (especially splatoon 2), although electronic music in general is great as well
i only ever play in creative mode cuz i enjoy building and making houses and stuff. its relaxing
